newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 drops as dealers mull cap mkt plans.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 drops as dealers mull cap mkt plans.

text.p: Czech shares continued to trade on low volumes on Thursday with traders digesting a government announcement on Wednesday aimed at boosting growth, cutting the trade deficit and restoring credibility to the much maligned Czech capital markets.
While welcoming the new measures, dealers said prices would probably continue to stagnate until better regulation of the equity market actually comes into force.
"We have heard this discussion for quite a long time...I think that a market reaction could be seen only after some real results," said Karel Ruzicka of ING Barings.
The PX50 edged slightly lower on Thursday, falling 0.2 points, 0.04 percent, to 550.8.
The losses were driven by late falls in continuous trading from SPT Telecom, which dropped 48 crowns to 3,435, and Komercni Banka which lost 38 crowns to 2,261.
Both shares had posted strong gains on Wednesday.
